exact_invariants.added_cut_position: Writing Phi(c) for the sum of the proper prefix sums of c, a split at cut j has Phi(child)-Phi(parent)=j. Therefore sum_e j(e)f(e)=-sum_c Phi(c)w4(c), independent of f.
exact_invariants.edge_coordinate_ranges: For d<=10, every coordinate minimum and maximum is exact; minimum=maximum is a solver-independent invariant.
exact_invariants.rank_cut_flows: For every block-count cut, the total crossing flow equals the cumulative w4 divergence on lower ranks.
exact_invariants.reflected_position: This equals (d+1) times total_internal_flow minus added_cut_position, so it is also fixed on the feasible set.
exact_invariants.total_internal_flow: The sum of all edge flows is the sum of the forced rank-cut flows, so the total_internal_flow objective is constant on the entire feasible set.

sample_warning: Equality among saved certificates alone is not treated as an invariant; variation is a valid nonuniqueness witness, while sampled equality is only descriptive.
